propositions: Extract binding identity transition rules from BindingStore into a cohesive BindingLifecycle slice owning bind, confirm, unbind, reverse cleanup, and numeric-ID re-key operations while the public facade retains all signatures and coordination.
Every valid bind/confirm/unbind transition must leave at most one forward and one matching reverse identity, with targeted single-key pops rather than sweeps or ambiguity detection.

bind_confirm remains last-writer-wins on forward entry, popping exactly one differing old reverse key without sweep or abort, and stale reverse entries are removed only in explicitly permitted cases: rebind, unbind sweep, re-key, and retire.
Numeric-ID re-key operation moves issues by updating jira_key, resetting absent_404_count, stamping updated_at, popping old reverse key, and inserting new one, returning whether re-key occurred.

note_absent_or_rekey seam: lifecycle owns only the re-key mutation (step 4 and step-3 identity comparison); facade coordinator retains guard, no-client/no-id fallthrough, and by-id lookup, calling note_absent on negative re-key result.
Legacy records without numeric IDs retain current behavior and facade signatures without rewriting or aborting.
